about_the_game:
Free DLC: "Emergency Rescue" is Now Available!

Hey Hospital Administrators,

We are thrilled to announce that "Sim Hospital's" first free DLC, "Emergency Rescue," is now officially live! This new challenge will put your management and quick-thinking skills to the test.

DLC Content & Features

1. A New Story Arc

In "Emergency Rescue," you will take on a special mission to manage a hospital in dire need of help. Your goal is to complete tasks within a time limit, turn the hospital around, and earn rewards to bring back to your own hospital. Along the way, you'll experience a variety of different hospital styles and face more specialized medical challenges.

2. Unique Level-Based Mode

Unlike the main game, "Emergency Rescue" uses a level-based progression. You'll start with simple tasks and gradually face more challenging levels. Each level has a strict time limit, and your performance will directly affect your final rating and rewards. You must give it your all to achieve the highest rating, or you'll have to try again!

3. How to Access

Once your hospital reaches level 6, you can access the "Emergency Rescue" DLC. Simply find and click the "Emergency Rescue" speech bubble on the building near your hospital's entrance to start the new level challenges.

We look forward to seeing you excel in this new chapter and continue to create medical miracles!
